svg.title: Kartikeya Rajderkar
svg.desc: Dark hero. The name Kartikeya Rajderkar in large type, with the line "I build ML systems end to end, from the training loop to the desktop app." To the right, a training-loss curve descends across a faint dot grid and settles near zero, with an amber marker at its final point.
